title: YEEZY BOOST 700 MNVN
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN ‘Bone’ makes use of a high-contrast color scheme, highlighted by a cream polyester upper with black no-sew overlays at the toe and heel. No-tie bungee laces provide easy on and off, while reflective 700 branding on the sneaker’s quarter panel offers added visibility in low-light conditions. The seamless build rests on a sculpted black PU midsole, which houses drop-in Boost cushioning for a smooth ride.

title: YEEZY 450 INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy 450 Infants ‘Cinder’ gives the slip-on silhouette a monochrome makeover in a dark taupe hue. Constructed from a single piece of knit textile, the upper is equipped with no-tie elastic laces and a stretchy cuff that wraps around the ankle for a secure fit. Cradling the sock-like build is a PU injected midsole with tapered ‘fingers’ that extend up the sides. Underfoot, a contoured rubber outsole features a wavy traction pattern for maximum grip.
